title: Automated VST3 plugin validation and deployment

steps.name: Verify build artifacts exist
steps.validation: File exists and is a valid VST3 bundle

steps.name: Run plugin validator
steps.validation: Exit code 0 with no validation errors

steps.name: Run automated audio tests
steps.validation: All tests pass with 100% success rate

steps.name: Create deployment backup
steps.action: tar -czf /tmp/vst3-backup-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz -C ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3 VstTestPlayground.vst3 2>/dev/null || echo 'No existing plugin to backup'
steps.validation: Backup created or no previous version exists

steps.name: Deploy plugin to staging location
steps.validation: Plugin copied successfully and is accessible

steps.name: Verify plugin loads in DAW
steps.action: osascript -e 'tell application "Reaper" to activate' && sleep 5 && osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "r" using command down'
steps.validation: DAW starts and plugin scan completes without errors

steps.name: Run smoke tests
steps.validation: Plugin responds to parameter changes and produces audio output

rollback.name: Restore previous version if backup exists
rollback.action: LATEST_BACKUP=$(ls -t /tmp/vst3-backup-*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); if [ -n "$LATEST_BACKUP" ]; then tar -xzf "$LATEST_BACKUP" -C ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/; echo 'Restored from backup'; else echo 'No backup to restore'; fi
rollback.validation: Previous version restored or confirmed no backup existed

checks: Plugin file exists at deployment location
Plugin passes validator with no errors
Plugin loads in at least one DAW
successCriteria: VST3 plugin is deployed to staging location
All automated tests pass (100% success rate)
Plugin loads and responds to parameter changes in DAW
No audio dropouts or errors during smoke test

metadata.author: automation-system
metadata.safetyNotes: This automation modifies the VST3 plugins directory. Always create backups before deployment. Test in staging before production. Ensure no DAW sessions are actively using the plugin during deployment.
